ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.

8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.

Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood

Authorization to purchase traffic signal equipment for the Highway Safety Improvement Program (HSIP) Cycle 10 Citywide Leading Pedestrian Intervals (LPI) Project (Project No. CS22B). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Engineer II Edgeworth
Authorize the procurement and approve the sole source purchase of traffic signal equipment in the amount of $321,265 for the Citywide Leading Pedestrian Intervals Project (Project No. CS22B).
2024-02-14 Item 08D Auth to Purchase of Traffic Eqpt for LPI Project (CS22B)
8E.
Acceptance of the 1711 Eolus Avenue and Loch Lomond Drive Storm Drain Repair Projects (CD05E). Environmental Considerations: The actions being considered by the City Council are exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Engineer I Suleiman
1) Authorize the filing of the Notices of Completion for the subject projects; 2) Authorize the release of the payment bonds for the applicable subject projects in full upon the recording of the Notice of Completion; 3) Authorize the release of performance bonds for the applicable subject projects in full one (1) year after the recording of the Notices of Completion; 4) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2024-018, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Accepting the Public Improvements for the 1711 Eolus Avenue Storm Drain Repair (CD05E)"; and 5) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2024-019, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Accepting the Public Improvements for the Loch Lomond Drive Storm Drain Repair (CD05E)."

2024-02-14 Item 08F Legislative Position Letter SB 689
2024-02-14 Item 08F Legislative Position Letter SB 689 - Public Comments
8G.
Grant application for the Cardiff State Beach Living Shoreline project to allow continued support for long-term maintenance, monitoring and permitting requirements on this reach of coastline. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15060(c)(3) of the CEQA Guidelines because it is not a "project" as per Section 15378(b)(5). The action authorizes staff to implement an organizational or administrative activity of government that by itself will not result in a direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Costal Zone Administrator Mireau
Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to apply for funding from the State Coastal Conservancy to obtain the necessary permits and to allow additional maintenance and monitoring at the Cardiff State Beach Living Shoreline project.
2024-02-14 Item 08G State Coastal Conservancy Grant for Cardiff State Beach Living Shoreline

Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Emergency Declaration: Sediment cleanup from the Manchester Culvert to the San Elijo Lagoon. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM 10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the City Council if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing.
10A.
Public Hearing to consider a timely-filed appeal of a Director's Determination to require a Coastal Development Permit for the reconstruction of the fire-destroyed residential structure located on blufftop property and that the Coastal Bluff Overlay Zone regulations supersede the legal nonconforming regulations. CASE NO.: APPEAL-006885-2024; LOCATION: 1478 and 1480 Neptune Avenue (APN 254-040-26). Environmental Considerations: The timely-filed appeal is not subject to environmental review pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3) because the activity in question is not a project as defined by CEQA Guidelines Section 15378. The appeal involves consideration of a Director's Determination on application of the Zoning Regulations only and does not take action on, or authorize issuance of, a permit or an entitlement for a project.
Contact Person: Senior Planner Dichoso
Deny the appeal of the Director's Determination and adopt draft City Council Resolution No. 2024-16 titled, "A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council Denying an Appeal and Affirming a Director's Determination for the Property Located at 1478 and 1480 Neptune Avenue (CASE NO. APPEAL-006885-2024; APN: 254-040-26)", affirming the Director's Determination made on December 7, 2023.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
